1.en_consolidated_definition:
Heroine (n.) 

A female given name derived from the Greek word for "heroine" or "daughter of an hero". In some contexts, it may also refer to a woman who is considered a heroine or a female figure of great courage and strength.

In Puerto Rican culture, this term can also be associated with heroin, a highly addictive opioid drug.
